summary: Core University Living Real Estate Income Trust filed a routine Item 8.01 8-K on September 16, 2026, disclosing that the October 1, 2026 transaction price equals each class's August 31, 2026 NAV per share. Aggregate NAV was $132.4 million across 13.15 million shares, with Class A at $10.0668 and Class E at $10.0741 per share. NAV components include $307.5 million of student-housing properties offset by $180.4 million mortgage debt and $6.0 million other liabilities. The independent valuation advisor used a 5.87% exit cap rate and 7.62% discount rate. No special-situation event is present.
